notation_notes.note: eigenvalues listed with algebraic multiplicity as lambda_1,...,lambda_1,lambda_{m1+1},...,lambda_n; this is a compressed convention, not an error
c2 V2 e^{lambda_1 x} follows the same convention: first m1 eigenvalues all equal lambda_1
sentence writes alpha_0,...,alpha_n; should be alpha_0,...,alpha_{n-1} (n coefficients)
wording 'first (m-1) derivatives of Delta vanish'; precise form is Delta^{(j)}(lambda_i)=0 for j=0,...,m-1
r^{m1-1} should be read as r^{(m1-1)} (derivative order)
